title: Enclaved Land Count
summary: Count land cells that cannot reach the grid boundary through land.
statement: Count land cells that cannot reach the grid boundary through land. Implement `enclaved_land_count` and return the required result without changing the callable signature.
constraints: Inputs follow the declared Python and JSON-compatible types.
Return a deterministic result for every valid input.
hints: Only land connected to a boundary can escape.
Flood-fill from every boundary land cell, then count unvisited land.
Pseudocode checkpoint: identify the state, update it once per step, and return only after the enclaved_land_count invariant is complete.
Editorial: Flood-fill from every boundary land cell, then count unvisited land. The intended bounds are O(rc) time and O(rc) space.
editorial: Only land connected to a boundary can escape. Flood-fill from every boundary land cell, then count unvisited land. This yields O(rc) time and O(rc) auxiliary space.
